instruction: Open the provided init.ifc row-house shell in Bonsai. Coordinate it into three units with shared party walls instead of duplicate separator walls, then save the completed IFC4 model as result.ifc. The result should contain one project, one building storey, three spaces, six walls, and one slab. Name the spaces Unit A, Unit B, and Unit C. Name the walls Shell-S, Shell-N, Shell-W, Shell-E, Party-AB, and Party-BC, with exactly two wall names beginning with Party. Do not include building element proxies, furnishing elements, doors, windows, opening elements, void relationships, or fill relationships. Other details may vary.
